source_route_detail: Route A: one MC-GPU process over @manifest; geometry parsed once; each sub-fan still writes its own dose tally
bit_identity_note: One further modification hoists the geometry parse out of the sub-fan loop. It changes no physics: on a full 10-replica reference set computed with the unmodified engine, all 144 dose arrays are SHA-256 identical and the scored VOI values are bit-identical (results/phase1a/replica_120kvp_second_K4_L40_00 vs results/phase1a/replica_120kvp_second_K4_L40_00_routeA).
